# Opinion poll (`poll` v1)

A voting-intention poll: fieldwork, sample, method and shares with margins of error.

**Group:** Politics and society · **Mnemonic:** `POLL` · **Identifiers:** `POLL-…` in `pollId`

Open one with `POLL <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: poll
version: 1
description: "A voting-intention poll: fieldwork, sample, method and shares with margins of error."
match: { kind: poll, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Politics and society · Opinion poll, id: $.pollId }
strip:
  - { label: Pollster, bind: $.pollster }
  - { label: Fieldwork, bind: $.fieldwork }
  - { label: Sample, bind: $.sample, fmt: amount0 }
  - { label: Method, bind: $.method }
  - { label: Lead, bind: $.lead, emphasis: true }
  - { label: Margin of error, bind: $.moe, fmt: pct2 }
panels:
  - id: shares
    kind: table
    title: Voting intention
    key: F2
    rows: $.shares
    columns:
      - { label: Party, bind: "@.party" }
      - { label: Share, bind: "@.share", fmt: pct0, total: true }
      - { label: Low, bind: "@.low", fmt: pct0 }
      - { label: High, bind: "@.high", fmt: pct0 }
      - { label: Change, bind: "@.change", fmt: signed2, tone: sign }
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.jurisdiction, 'jurisdiction')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
